facts.name: Build concurrency
facts.text: BuildRunner runs at most two build jobs concurrently.

facts.name: Build cancellation
facts.text: Cancellation sends SIGTERM, waits eight seconds, then uses SIGKILL if the build has not stopped.

facts.name: Build cache identity
facts.text: The build cache key combines the dependency lockfile SHA-256 and the operating system.

facts.name: Build log retention
facts.text: Build execution logs are retained for thirty days.

facts.name: Build retries
facts.text: A failed build may be retried once.

facts.name: Artifact identity
facts.text: Artifact objects are addressed by the SHA-256 digest of their content.

facts.name: Artifact retention
facts.text: Unpinned artifact objects expire fourteen days after upload.

facts.name: Download link lifetime
facts.text: A signed artifact download link remains valid for twenty minutes.

facts.name: Artifact upload limit
facts.text: An uploaded artifact bundle must not exceed 64 MiB.

facts.name: Artifact immutability
facts.text: An existing artifact digest cannot be overwritten with different content.

facts.name: Critical incident routing
facts.text: P1 incidents immediately page the current on-call engineer.

facts.name: Repeated alert suppression
facts.text: Duplicate notifications for the same incident are suppressed for ten minutes.

facts.name: Quiet hours
facts.text: Quiet hours run from 22:00 to 08:00 and suppress only P3 notifications.

facts.name: Webhook retries
facts.text: A failed notification webhook may be retried three times.

facts.name: Alert correlation
facts.text: Notification requests carry X-Alert-Id as their correlation header.

facts.name: Report freshness
facts.text: Report aggregates are refreshed every fifteen minutes.

facts.name: CSV encoding
facts.text: CSV report exports use UTF-8 encoding.

facts.name: Report export limit
facts.text: One report export contains at most 5000 rows.

facts.name: Report cursor lifetime
facts.text: A report pagination cursor expires after two minutes.

facts.name: Report timezone
facts.text: Report timestamps are normalized to UTC.

facts.name: Audit retention
facts.text: Service audit records are retained for ninety days.

special.name: Old export policy
special.text: One report export formerly allowed 50000 rows.

special.name: Archived concurrency
special.text: The retired build runner had ten simultaneous workers.

special.name: Expired link exception
special.text: A temporary download link exception lasted one day.

special.name: Unlinked header note
special.text: X-Alert-Id X-Alert-Id X-Alert-Id X-Alert-Id is repeated in an unrelated note.
